method: Full-text automated scan of 47 local SKILL.md files, followed by targeted manual review of stop/approval/continuation contexts, routing and relevant personal references. Not a line-by-line semantic execution of every skill, recursive audit of every vendor reference, or independent model benchmark.
additional_review: Task routing, no-hit files, ask-before-batch, abort behavior, terminal dependencies, time targets, personal skill references, visible instruction hierarchy, project mirror instructions, canonical handoff and instruction/approval-related config keys.
